The relationships between quarterly and half-year figures are logically presented, with clear explanations for variances (e.g., inflation impact in S7, restructuring charge in S11). The organization follows a logical flow from income statement items to balance sheet highlights and strategic updates. There is no unnecessary repetition that materially reduces clarity.
